definitions.explanation: Material used to build or finish walls — for example plaster, plasterboard, tile, or wood paneling. Built from {壁|かべ} (wall) + {材|ざい} (material).

examples.japanese: ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧な{壁材|かべざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: We chose a natural wall material.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{壁材|かべざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{湿気|しっけ}→湿気：03177_shikke⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: This wall material is resistant to moisture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧{壁材|かべざい}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: A room's atmosphere changes greatly depending on the wall material you choose.

notes:
A construction and interior-design term for any material that makes up or covers a wall.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {壁材|かべざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose a wall material
- ⟦{内装|ないそう}→内装：06425_naisou⟧{壁材|かべざい}: interior wall material

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{床材|ゆかざい}→床材：25463_yukazai⟧: flooring material — the parallel '{...}⟦{材|ざい}→〜材：28347_zai⟧' term for floors
- ⟦{建材|けんざい}→建材：12646_kenzai⟧: building material — the broad category covering all construction materials
